opening.argument: The opportunity is presented through online registration, a paid entry, and income tied directly to recruiting others and their business activity. The speaker says, “if you build a downline you will get paid” and describes payment for signing up businesses, linking earnings to continued recruitment and transactions. The presentation also promotes passive income through registration and offers a short-term example of coworkers reportedly making $1000-1500 in their first 20 days. These claims are used to support participation, alongside a possible large payday from an acquisition. That outcome is expressly conditional, and the evidence does not establish that the cited earnings or outcomes occurred. The combination of recruitment-based commissions, tiered downline payments, and earnings claims nevertheless supports the position that this is a scam opportunity.
